about.paragraph1: We automate the migration from Apache NiFi 1.x to 2.x with advanced AI. Forget manual work, human errors, and weeks of reconfiguration.
about.paragraph2: Perfect for DevOps teams, data engineers, and architects who seek efficiency, security, and full traceability.

steps.title: 1. Upload your NiFi 1.x Flow

steps.title: 2. AI Analyzes and Converts
steps.desc: Our model reviews processors, controllers, and connections, proposing the optimal equivalences in NiFi 2.x.

steps.title: 3. Receive Your Report
steps.desc: Download a detailed report including equivalences, critical points, and actionable recommendations.
